import re

def parse_grid_block(txt, start, end=None):
 s=txt.index(start)+len(start)
 e=txt.index(end,s) if end else len(txt)
 rows=[]
 for line in txt[s:e].strip().splitlines():
  line=line.strip()
  if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9 ]+',line): rows.append([int(x) for x in line.split()])
 return rows
